title: Father Kneels to Beg Mercy, I Ruin His Life!
Wo Xie Wan Zong Ta Long Que

overview: This series features the adventures of a cantankerous duck, Saturnin, and his companions (the police dog, foxes, marmots, cat, goat, Professor Popof, Jeannot Rabbit, Lady Weasel...) in their village where animals can, for example, drive cars, eat at the table, live comfortably, garden or even go skiing. Saturnin is also a secret agent who foils the plans of a weasel or ferret.
title: Les aventures de Saturnin

overview: The amusing adventures of Ron, the unemployed bachelor living in a crumbling apartment. He's 36 now, and his uneventful way of life is getting to him. Could he break out of his old habits and have a chance of happiness.
title: Ron

overview: Join openly gay but closeted geeks, Toby, Rae, Andy, Fab and Max as their lives, loves and never-ending dramas play out with hilarious consequences. Outland is a show about belonging, no matter who you are, and how everyone searches to find a place to fit in.
title: Outland

overview: The story takes place in the 1960s and follows Manu, a young fisherman from Saint-Jean-de-Luz who experiments with a new fishing technique, attracting the hostility of a wealthy couple.
title: Les Moissons de l'océan

overview: Set in Brittany at the beginning of the 20th century, it follows the life of Pierre, the son of a poor shoemaker named Célestin. Due to extreme poverty, Pierre is sent away to be raised by nuns and later by harsh foster parents on a farm.
title: Le Fils du cordonnier

overview: Strong-willed Kausar defies societal barriers for her daughter Seher's big dreams, but will destiny stand by their side?
title: Seher hone ko hai

overview: Inside the season that finally gave the league the spotlight it deserves, through thrilling game footage and exclusive interviews with the athletes.
title: The Rise

overview: Glimpse the drama happening in the school hallways of Shadyside & Sunnyside and discover the secret adventures that unfold.
title: Locker Diaries: ZOMBIES

overview: Filmed on location in a real museum after dark, surrounded by priceless artefacts, taxidermy and historical curiosities, Alex Lee guides four celebrity players through a series of challenges and quizzes that deliver gags quick and fast.
title: Tonight At The Museum

overview: On Dirty Laundry Live, Lawrence Mooney and his panel of celebrity guests will pull apart the major pop culture stories of the week in an unpredictable, irreverent and unscripted live-to-air quiz show, where anything could happen. Whether you're a trashmag subscriber, a celebrity blog addict or just a doctor's waiting room time-passer, join Lawrence and his guests each week as they chew up and spit out all the celebrity trash and glamour they can manage.
title: Dirty Laundry Live

overview: True-crime series focusing on the hunt for elusive killers.
title: Killer on the Run

overview: "Stroitel" club was once a successful team, and its owner dreamed of one day having the chance to move beyond its current league and earn a place in the KHL. But the players and coaching staff have fallen into a deep slump, leaving the team at the bottom of the standings with no way out. Now, it seems easier to shut down the club and its arena altogether. Losing faith in the team's chances of turning things around on the ice, "Stroitel's" owner appoints a figure skating coach as the club's director. The club's survival now depends on whether the former skater can unite the players, forge a bond between the team and its fans, who are considered the equivalent of a sixth player on the ice, and become the club's "seventh player" by finding success from behind the management desk.
title: Седьмой игрок

overview: Adventurer Ed Stafford courses the world to experience how indigenous peoples turn boys into men.
title: Ed Stafford's Rite of Passage

overview: December 2021, a man with Covid wakes up from a coma in a Glasgow hospital surrounded by detectives. They say he is Nicholas Rossi, one of America's most wanted fugitives. He claims to be a disabled academic called Arthur Knight. This is the astonishing story of one of the world's most dangerous conmen and the transatlantic battle for justice.
title: Nicholas Rossi: Predator on Trial

overview: Set in Greece, Two Weeks in August tells the story of a woman who goes on holiday with her family and friends to rediscover joy in her life. But here in paradise, what starts with an illicit kiss, quickly turns the dream holiday into a nightmare. Zoe begins to act on her deepest desires and the holiday she hoped for becomes a reckoning for a group of adults who refuse to grow up. When they discover they are trapped on the island, and become faced with real life-or-death situations, the group soon turn on each other to find out who is to blame. Is Zoe responsible for the drama and destruction around her or, as heaven turns to hell, are bigger forces at play? We are in Greece after all, the land of the ancient Gods…
title: Two Weeks in August

overview: Antiques Roadshow experts examine and value antiques and collectables.
title: Antiques Roadshow

overview: Postcode follows a group of different young people from different diverse backgrounds who all live in the same postcode. Jamal, Zac, and Sheela all live in the same postcode but have very different lives. The series is created by Tony Marchant.
title: Postcode

overview: Autumn 1943. An enemy shepherd dog attacks a Soviet reconnaissance group during a sortie. Defending themselves, the soldiers open fire, giving away their location and coming under mortar fire. Having narrowly escaped death, the head of the Gromov reconnaissance group takes the injured dog with him and asks the surgeon to perform surgery on her and save the animal. When the dog recovers, Gromov is going to reform him and unsuccessfully tries to establish contact with him. Corporal Miroshnikov helps the hero find a common language with the dog. Soon, thanks to kindness and ingenuity, he manages to turn the dog into an assistant who is ready to go with him on exploration and perform difficult tasks. But one day Gromov meets the former owner of Rex, who tries to force the dog to remember old habits and commands.…
title: Солдат по кличке Рекс

overview: In Fame to Table join Television Host Matthew Hoffman, as he interviews famous chefs about the dish that made them famous - peeling back the apron one delicious and distinguished dish at a time.
title: Fame to Table: With Matthew Hoffman

overview: Set in the criminal underworld of Los Angeles with a dark but over the top Miami Vice vibe, Girltrash! follows the story of five ass-kicking girls, getting by any way they can, even if it means double crossing your best friend or former lover.
title: Girltrash!

overview: In 2003, two young men emerge from the forests of British Columbia claiming to have been raised entirely off the grid. As a small town tries to help them, a mystery unfolds, testing how far people will go to believe the unbelievable.
title: Wild Boys: Strangers in Town

overview: In October 1994, lawyer Valery Karyshev received a client, whose name, according to the terms of the contract, must be kept secret. This man is the legendary killer Alexander Solonik, who received the nickname "Macedonian" for his ability to shoot simultaneously with two hands. Solonik, who was wounded in a shootout with police officers, is placed in a special unit of the Matrosskaya Tishina detention center. Upon learning that the killer has already made two successful escapes from the courtroom and from the zone, the jailers transfer him to solitary confinement. For the murder of policemen and thieves in law, the killer faces, in addition to a court sentence, two more unofficial, death sentences - from comrades of the deceased policemen and from the mafia. Realizing that death cannot be avoided, Solonik plans an escape, in which his masters, former generals of the special services, must help him.
title: Александр Македонский

overview: To catch the drug dealer Brown, an experienced Moscow operative, Zverev, is called to Odessa. His goal is to infiltrate the gang. A confirmed bachelor, he must come with his wife and son for the authenticity of the legend. The charming Masha Yakovleva, an employee of the archive of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the widow of a police captain, was chosen for the role of his wife. Her son Pavlik is supposed to play Zverev's son. Everything is not going according to plan in this risky business from the very beginning.
title: Холостяк

overview: On New Years Eve, three young people become single at the same time. Cho is an artist and owner of a silk screen printing business who's shocked when a surprise marriage proposal goes south. Timor, Cho's close friend since high school, gets her heart broken that same day when her western boyfriend breaks up with her instead of proposing as she'd imagined. Cho's nerdy younger brother Saiya discovers that the sexy woman he's been chatting with online for so long never truly existed; it was just a prank his friends were playing on him. All three of them are single in a flash like lightning. The hi-so widow Yves Saint, Cho's office landlord, has to cheer the three up. She promises a big reward to the person who can find a new partner before the end of the year.
title: Melodies of Life: My Name is Single

overview: Todd Sampson explores the intriguing complexities of human behaviour, driven by a curiosity to unravel the mysteries behind our actions. Each episode embarks on a quest to understand the things people do.
title: Todd Sampson's Why?

overview: Marc Fennell sets out to uncover the truth behind John Friedrich, the man who deceived a nation. He reveals a story that's stranger than fiction, delving into a web of lies and money. In the 1980s, John Friedrich ran an elite sea and land rescue squad in Victoria, winning an Order of Australia, top-secret government contracts and hundreds of millions of dollars in loans. But no one knew that John Friedrich was not who he made out to be. His undoing revealed one of the most audacious scams in Australian history, worth an estimated $900 million in today's money.
title: Australia's Greatest Conman?

overview: The Café is a British sitcom written by and starring Ralf Little and Michelle Terry broadcast by Sky1. The series premiered on 23 November 2011. A second series was produced and commenced airing on 24 July 2013. In November 2013 it was announced that the series was cancelled.
title: The Café

overview: Yusup dreamed of becoming a movie star and blogger, but he is turning into a star of the trading floor. A loser actor uses a fake resume and, thanks to chance, becomes the director of a huge hypermarket! His methods are outrageous, but damn effective. Now the hypermarket is plunging into an absurd mockumentary reality, where the aroma of barbecue at the checkout and non-standard promotions "blow up" sales and the lives of employees. Unsurpassed Yusup Omarov in the new series, in the role of ex-actor and CEO Yusup Sakhratulaevich.
title: Твой дом

overview: The "Minskys" are in the ground! At the end of 2024, Improv Minsk — Sergey Shevelev, Maxim Zayats, Sergey Gorokh, Artyom Gaus — went on tour with their exclusive improvisational show. Tyumen, Omsk, Samara, Krasnoyarsk, Novosibirsk, Yekaterinburg, St. Petersburg and Moscow are the cities that the boys visited as part of the autumn tour. For information about how the concerts went and what happened to the improvisers between performances, see the exclusive VK Video in the blog.
title: ВЛОГ IMPROV.МИНСК

overview: The year is 2045. Life on the planet is almost destroyed. Robots run everything. The remnants of civilization are being destroyed by ruthless cyborg Inspectors. The survivors decide to send one Checker back in time to prevent the creation of an evil Supercomputer responsible for the apocalypse. He must find Anton Pronin, the future leader of the Resistance, and now an honest employee of Roskontrolnadzor. But the Examiner needs to hurry, because the Chosen One is about to die.
title: Проверятор

overview: Tradition is alive as long as it is able to change. And items created with traditional motifs allow you to talk to customers. These principles are followed by small brands from national republics. They create unique collections, conveying through them the cultural code and the spirit of the people. And more and more people want to enter into a so-called dialogue with them. In the Fresh Russia project, we will tell you how local products win the hearts of Russians.
title: Свежая Россия

overview: A person in a difficult life situation is an ideal victim for a recruiter. Desperate from financial problems, people easily succumb to manipulation and persuasion if they are promised to earn extra money. Moreover, at first they are given very simple tasks: to post a post, to put up ads. The euphoria of easy earnings, along with the techniques of social engineering from scammers, do not allow you to come to your senses and "get off the hook." But instead of solving problems, a person gets difficulties with the law and a real sentence for vandalism or terrorism. "The ribbon.<url> has studied how recruiters work and who becomes their victims.
title: Попавшие в сети

overview: 80 years ago, the Nuremberg trials began — the main world trial of the criminals of Nazi Germany. As a result, 12 of the main actors of the war were sentenced to death, while others received large and even life sentences. It seemed that the crimes of Nazism were in the distant past. But time has shown that Nazism is as tenacious as a terrible virus. "The ribbon.<url>" and the National Center for Historical Memory under the President of the Russian Federation begin a cycle of materials for the project "Without a statute of limitations. The truth about Nazism", which will tell about the crimes of Nazi Germany.
title: Без срока давности. Правда о нацизме

overview: For more than two years, the West has been criticizing Russia for the special military operation launched in February 2022 in Ukraine. However, over the past 50 years, the United States and its allies have repeatedly invaded the territories of sovereign states that posed no threat to them in the name of their political and economic interests. Citizens of Guatemala, Serbia, Iraq, and Afghanistan well remember the full-scale military interventions that plunged their countries into chaos, led to numerous civilian casualties, and destroyed the economy. Most of these conflicts were unleashed under far-fetched pretexts and without the approval of the UN Security Council. That is why most developing countries have not sided with the United States and its allies in condemning Russia, considering the claims of Western elites who put their interests above international norms and stop at nothing to protect them to be untenable.
title: Право на вторжение

overview: These people have changed the world we live in. Geniuses, creators and daredevils. Their actions influenced the destinies of millions, their discoveries and decisions turned the idea of human capabilities upside down. They were ahead of their time, admired and became the idols of generations. And each of them has an incredible life.
title: Жизнь замечательных людей

overview: These intense gazes, this tension... you're really telling me there's nothing between them? The subtle undercurrent flowing between them creates breathtaking suspense! Colleagues? Rivals? Lovers? The boundaries are becoming blurred.
title: ONnOFF

overview: What's it like to be a Muslim and living in the United States? This series attempts to find out, as it follows the daily lives of five American Muslim families in Dearborn, Mich., home to the largest mosque in the U.S. Each episode offers details of a world most Americans know little about -- the customs and celebrations of American Muslims, as well as the misconceptions, conflicts and differences they face both outside and within their own community. The families featured share the same religion but lead very distinct lives that at times challenge the Muslim stereotype.
title: All-American Muslim

overview: Scooby-Doo: Origins is a modern reimagining of the iconic mystery-solving group of teens and their very special dog. During their final summer at camp, old friends Shaggy and Daphne get embroiled in a haunting mystery surrounding a lonely lost Great Dane puppy that may have been a witness to a supernatural murder. Together with the pragmatic and scientific townie, Velma, and the strange, but ever so handsome new kid, Freddy, they set out to solve the case that is pulling each of them into a creepy nightmare that threatens to expose all of their secrets.
title: Scooby-Doo: Origins

overview: When tragedy strikes her traveling theatre troupe, Joud must face a scarred past and an unjust present—where loss, justice, and hope collide as she uncovers a truth more perilous than imagined.
title: Bil Haram

overview: In her past life, Su Miao was misled by slander and grew to hate Qin Yan. Only after death did she realize he had protected her with his own life. Reborn seven years back to the night she was framed and disgraced, she chooses to embrace the young man she once wronged. In this new life, she takes the initiative to stand by him and plot revenge together, swearing to take down the hypocritical Crown Prince and her vicious half-sister once and for all.
title: A Feast of Fate

overview: Returning to the atmosphere of Thailand thirty years previous, this story reflects the exploitation of the marganlised through a tribal woman whose life takes a dark turn, transforming her into a vengeful spirit.
title: Muifei the Medium

overview: Branded the ‘Female Charles Manson,' Sarah Pender escapes prison sparking a nationwide manhunt.
title: Girl on the Run: The Hunt For America's Most Wanted Woman

overview: Big Sexy is a three-part reality series that premiered on TLC on Tuesday, August 30 at 10:00 PM (ET/PT). The series chronicles five plus-size women, all of whom work in the fashion industry (and all of whom were friends before the series began), and their lives in New York City. On December 2, 2011, the first three episodes began re-airing on Discovery Fit & Health.
title: Big Sexy

overview: This series recounts the travels of a modern-day adventurer, Raner, who hides behind the identity of Mr. Duvallier, a prominent figure. A former gangster presumed dead, Raner takes on the guise of an elderly, wealthy businessman to become a philanthropist and improve the human condition. Only his secretary, Laurence, knows his secret.
title: L'Étrange Monsieur Duvallier

overview: Ryan Reynolds reads new and classic bedtime stories as the tales magically come to life around him – creating a warm, playful and imaginative wind-down experience for kids and parents to enjoy together.
title: Bedtime Stories with Ryan

overview: Three teenage girls share an unbreakable bond until terrible secrets threaten to emerge on social media. When one friend vanishes, the search for answers unearths a web of lies, betrayal, and murder - sending shockwaves through an unsuspecting community.
title: Friends Like These: The Murder of Skylar Neese

overview: Canada's Drag Race: All Stars welcomes back queens with unfinished business to compete for the chance to be crowned "Canada's Ultimate All-Star," and win a cash prize of $100,000.
title: Canada's Drag Race: All Stars

overview: In Korea, nothing defines success more than owning a building. Ki Su-jong, once an ordinary office worker, believes that going all in—risking everything and drowning in debt—to finally become a landlord will be his way out. But when global capital swoops in and threatens to push his building into foreclosure, Su-jong clings to a desperate plan with his best friend: a staged kidnapping in the building's basement that spirals into a real one. Trapped in a chain of crimes that could destroy his life or save it, Su-jong is forced to make impossible choices. How far will he go to keep his dream from collapsing?
title: Mad Concrete Dreams

overview: The global pastry survival project, Bake Your Dream, brings together the world's finest masters. From Korea's top pastry chefs and world-renowned patissiers to hidden gems with extraordinary recipes, contestants armed with their own secret weapons and distinct philosophies take the stage to vie for the ultimate title. Amidst fierce missions, will the veterans shine with their flawless technique, or will bold, fresh ideas steal the spotlight? With their unique characters, philosophies, and skills at their fingertips, the battle begins the moment they step before the oven. Taste, aroma, devotion, and creativity collide in this arena as the world's most enchanting pastries are born.
title: Bake Your Dream

overview: Some of the country's most driven defense attorneys work at the law firm Matsson & Moradi, and they risk ending up dangerously close to the limits of the law and morality. Cast: Arvin Kananian, Björn Bengtsson, Tiril Wishman, Kit Walker Johansson and others. Director: Lisa Linnertorp. Based on an original idea by Jens Lapidus.
title: Hundarna

overview: Russian Dolls follows colorful women and men who live, love and work in Brooklyn, New York. In the midst of the Russian-American community. The multi-generational families have drama that matches that of the other reality stars with drama and dreams to contend with their Russian heritage. Together they are going to be living in the same household to have fun and party as the Russians like to.
title: Russian Dolls

overview: The "Zhdi Menya" program is a large—scale television project that uses unique artistic means to create a high sense of belonging among viewers to the destinies of other people and the history of the country. The true drama, subtle lyrics and artistic persuasiveness of the program determine its national recognition and enormous impact on the audience, confirmed by the multimillion response in Russia and abroad.
title: Жди меня

overview: Solveig and John is renovating a house in Italy
title: Solveig og Johns dolce villa

overview: After years of suffering, Rahma ends up in a tyrannical marriage. Torn between seeking revenge and rewriting her destiny, Rahma gathers the strength to face her past and build herself a new life.
title: Rahma

overview: Former members of the Jehovah's Witnesses share their stories of lesser-known aspects of the faith that have remained hidden for decades.
title: Sobrevivir al Paraíso: Más allá de los Testigos de Jehová

overview: This chilling docuseries chronicles one of Poland's most notorious cold cases -- the brutal 1999 murder of female student Katarzyna Zowada.
title: Morderca szyty na miarę

overview: Two life-long friends lead a daring expedition deep in the Australian Outback, to find a legendary, multi-billion-dollar fortune in gold and solve a 100 year old mystery. In 1897 gold prospector, Harrold Lasseter, staggered out of the desert claiming to have discovered a massive outcrop of gold. Decades later, he set out to rediscover his lost fortune, alone he perished in the desert, taking the location of his gold to the grave. Six outback missions and 40 years later, Jeff and Brendan are more determined than ever to find Lasseter's gold and prove that he was a telling the truth. Now with specialist help and cutting-edge technology, they plan to retrace Lasseter's fateful 1930 expedition, scouring the Outback for clues that Lasseter left behind that will lead them to his fortune. Their quest: survive the outback, discover the truth…and just maybe become billionaires in the process!
title: Hunting Outback Gold

overview: Reset centres on Gidi Bar-Lavi, a 50-year-old man who is mistakenly diagnosed with a terminal illness. Believing he is about to die, Gidi embarks on a spectacular life implosion: quitting his job, destroying his marriage, torching relationships and embracing reckless freedom. When the diagnosis turns out to be wrong, Gidi is forced to confront the wreckage he's left behind — and the far harder task of facing life instead of death. But now, faced with the before and the aftermath, which life will he choose?
title: Reset

overview: Make a date with the Gigolos. Showtime presents an extremely rare and uncensored look into the personal and professional lives of five hot guys in Vegas who like to hang out, have fun and get girls… but in their case they get paid for it. A reality series like no other, Gigolos is not only provocative but also surprisingly truthful and heartfelt. It's a wild ride for these real-life escorts who never miss a trick.
title: Gigolos

overview: After the Great Earthquake, the world is razed to the ground. In the lone apartment complex left standing, survivors have established the Hwang Gung Market, where cash is dead and canned food is the new currency. Everything, from fuel to intelligence, is traded here. Park Sang-yong, the President of the Merchants, rules the market with an iron fist, forcing people to find their own ways to survive under his absolute order. But the status quo is shattered when a mysterious girl, He-ro, sneaks in to steal canned food. After discovering Sang-yong's fatal secret, she proposes a treacherous deal to his right-hand man, Tae-jin. As the Market's solid order begins to crack, alliance and betrayal become mere choices for survival. Who will endure to emerge as the master of the Market?
title: Concrete Market

overview: Famous Last Words, a groundbreaking documentary series spotlighting renowned cultural icons secretly giving their final interviews - which will be announced and aired posthumously.
title: Famous Last Words

overview: In the city that never sleeps, a group of New Yorkers navigates the biggest transitions of their lives — marriage, parenthood, reinvention, and the reality of growing up without growing apart. Can they have it all, or will they need to choose between the lives they've built and the futures they never saw coming?
title: In the City

overview: Combining personal stories and footage to take you inside the destructive firestorms that tore through Los Angeles in January 2025.
title: LA Firestorm: Inside the Inferno

overview: Kanata is a handsome young man who can't help but be the center of attention, even when his mind is miles away. Akira is the perfect student who barely talks to anyone. They don't know each other's classes or even their names, but they can't forget each other's faces. One day, these two happen to meet on a stairwell near the rooftop. From then on, that roof becomes their secret rendezvous spot. Slowly they discover that while they might be very different on the outside, they both have feelings for each other. Is this a case of opposites attract, or are the differences too great for them to ever truly connect?
title: Contrast

overview: The series tells the story of how Ukrainian farmers overcome the challenges of war and how Russian aggression exacerbates the world's food crisis. The heroes of the film are employees of large-scale enterprises, owners of farms and local entrepreneurs. Some of them were forced to relocate their farms, others - to withstand the horrors of occupation, enemy shelling, mining of fields and other disasters caused by Russian troops.
title: Фермерство під час війни

overview: We explore the stories of Ukrainians who could have lived and worked abroad, but returned during a difficult time for Ukraine to be useful and help locally: fighting, volunteering, starting businesses, etc.
title: Повернення додому

overview: Join host Jules Asner when she interviews some of the hottest stars of today. Including Alyssa Milano, Mike Myers, and Jennifer Love Hewitt. You will find out about the star's marriage life, childhood, claim to fame and more! So sit down and enjoy the Revealed life of a star.
title: Revealed with Jules Asner

overview: Rebuilding cities is not just about construction, but about restoring life, communities and meaning after the destruction caused by war. That is why, as part of the "Rebuilding Cities" project, we are telling the story of how Ukrainian towns and villages scarred by war are coming back to life.
title: Відновлення міст

overview: Xu Xiao is a gifted yet arrogant restoration specialist with exceptional craftsmanship, while Zhao Xiaocen struggles with social anxiety. The two meet in a ceramics restoration class and become partners. With Xu Xiao's support, Zhao Xiaocen gradually opens up, while Xu Xiao, influenced by her, begins to reconcile his family conflicts. After enduring misunderstandings and setbacks in their relationship, they find their way back to each other. Together, they embark on a journey to preserve cultural heritage and face the challenges of the future.
title: Glaze of Love

overview: The guys from StukTV take six well-known friends on a terrifying road trip to England's four most notorious haunted locations. They are dropped off at night and confronted with inexplicable stories, bizarre sightings, and their own fears. Each location is more intense than the last. Every night becomes more exciting. Fate decides each night which daredevils must face their fears. Who is the least afraid and will survive... De Drop?
title: De Drop: De Engste Roadtrip

overview: Narrow Escapes of World War II tells the real stories of courageous and deadly fights against impossible odds during World War II.
title: Narrow Escapes of World War II

overview: Entertainment series which ran from 1953 to 1983 and recreated the atmosphere of the music hall with songs and sketches of the era performed by modern-day performers.
title: The Good Old Days

overview: CNN Original Series Standoff: The FBI, Power and Paranoia will examine the fragile, high-risk relationship between FBI Directors and then U.S. Presidents they serve, spotlighting the moments when that balance is pushed to the brink. Each episode focuses on a defining confrontation that reverberated far beyond the Oval Office, starting with former FBI Director James Comey's own account of his infamous clash with President Donald Trump. Episodes also uncover the long-simmering fracture between J. Edgar Hoover and President Richard Nixon, the strained relationship between President Bill Clinton and FBI Director Louis Freeh, and the post-9/11 alliance between President George W. Bush and FBI Director Robert Mueller. Pulling back the curtain on pivotal clashes between FBI Directors and Presidents of the United States, the series traces how personal loyalties, political pressure, and questions of power have shaped the FBI's role in American democracy and national security through archival footage, expert analysis, and firsthand accounts.
title: Standoff: The FBI, Power and Paranoia
